title: Cycle-compatible evaluation for a finite-free zero-differential complex
statement: Let C be a small site with topology S and commutative ring sheaf R [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let E and K be integer-indexed cochain complexes of R-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Assume E has zero differentials, is zero outside a finite interval, and each E^p is isomorphic to the free module on ULift(Fin r_p). Assume H^k(K)=0 for k unequal to zero. For n an integer put P=Hom(E,K) [def-pur-hom-complex] and let pi:P^n -> Hom(E^(-n),K^0) be the fixed product projection [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]. There exist an isomorphism f:H^n(P) -> Hom(H^(-n)(E),H^0(K)) and c:Z^n(P) -> Hom(Z^(-n)(E),Z^0(K)) with two identities: postcomposing c by the inclusion Z^0(K)->K^0 equals the product projection restricted to P-cycles and precomposed by Z^(-n)(E)->E^(-n); postcomposing c by the class map Z^0(K)->H^0(K) equals the P-class map followed by f and precomposition by Z^(-n)(E)->H^(-n)(E).

Apply invertibility of a supplied compatible map to f,c and both identities under hK,hzero,hsupp,hfree, then combine witnesses. The unchanged private helper additionally derives preservation of homology from finiteFreeInternalHomExact.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteFreeZero_homologyEvaluation
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {S : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf S CommRingCat.{u})
    (E K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose S (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (n : ℤ) (hK : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → IsZero (K.homology k))
    (hzero : ∀ a b : ℤ, E.d a b = 0)
    (hsupp : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ k : ℤ, k < a ∨ b < k → IsZero (E.X k))
    (hfree : ∀ k : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (E.X k ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) :
    let P := homComplex (R := R) E K
    let π := (Classical.choose (homComplex_projections_exists (R := R)))
      E K n (-n) 0 (by omega)
    ∃ f : P.homology n ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R)
        (E.homology (-n)) (K.homology 0),
      IsIso f ∧ ∃ c : P.cycles n ⟶
        SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (E.cycles (-n)) (K.cycles 0),
      c ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 _) (K.iCycles 0) =
        P.iCycles n ≫ π ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (E.iCycles (-n)) (𝟙 _) ∧
      c ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 _) (K.homologyπ 0) =
        P.homologyπ n ≫ f ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (E.homologyπ (-n)) (𝟙 _)
